text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike detected - SilverLynx org hitting sustained QPS +500% for the past 2m. Auto-throttling in effect. Alert: https://ops.redwood/s/alerts/4212345678

maria: seeing heavy 429s from SilverLynx in the dashboard. paging oncall.

jonathan: on it. quick assessment: traffic pattern is valid requests (no auth failures), looks like a batch job misfire. customer_id=org_7392 (SilverLynx).

jonathan: proposing temporary per-org cap bump from 500 -> 4000 qps and enable request-sampling to reduce cost while we contact CS. will coordinate rollback after stabilization.

maria: +1. document the change in thread and tag CS. leave a 15m timer and escalation policy.

jonathan: running infra command now:```bash
rwdctl org adjust-limit --org silverlynx --qps 4000 --duration 15m --reason "emergency spike - customer batch job"
```

incident-bot: Command executed by jonathan at 4212345688. JobID: job-9a4f. Change propagated to routing and token-bucket layer.

sam: confirmed increased limit applied on edge nodes. Observability: 5xxs down, 429s dropping ~92%. good signal.

alice: CS notified SilverLynx on-call (pager sent). letting them know we've applied an emergency capacity increase and will assist if they want us to throttle specific client keys.

jonathan: enabling request-sampling (1%) and prefix-KV cache to reduce backend load:```json
{"sampling": 0.01, "kv_cache": "prefix", "reason": "spike mitigation"}
```

support-bot: Sampling toggle accepted. Cache warmup starting (est. 45s).

maria: setting a 15m reminder for rollback and will handoff to sam at minute 10 for ongoing monitoring. if traffic normalizes, we'll roll back to 500 qps and open a post-incident with mitigation timeline.

sam: I'll keep watch and escalate to platform if we see errors creep back. also capturing cost impact to bill ops for review.

jonathan: note — we didn't touch rate-limiter ruleset, only per-org cap. if customer wants a permanent increase they need a plan + contract.

maria: follow-ups: (1) CS contact timestamped, (2) telemetry snapshot saved to /incidents/4212345678/telemetry.json, (3) runbook link: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/org-throttle-mitigation.

sam: 4212345702 — traffic stable, no new 5xx, 429s <5%. keeping the 15m window to finish coordination then rolling back unless SilverLynx asks otherwise.

jonathan: rollback executed at 4212345798 (manual override pre-scheduled):```bash
rwdctl org adjust-limit --org silverlynx --qps 500 --reason "rollback after emergency mitigation"
```

maria: closing notes — incident handled via emergency cap bump + sampling + cache. action items: CS to confirm customer cause, eng to consider per-key throttles as safer fallback, finance to estimate surge cost. tagging owners: @alice (CS), @jonathan (eng), @sam (ops). :white_check_mark:
